answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A echo delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A whisper check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A comet penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 3977 identities need 3977 bonds of 62 tokens, 57528 dollars of hardware and 56 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
